notes: Account: Meridian LegalTech Solutions — enterprise legal software provider focused on contract search, redaction, and AI-assisted drafting.
Qualification summary: Heavy security posture; must run in customer VPC or on-prem for regulated clients. Primary ask = Private VPC deployment with strict KMS control and audit log forwarding.
Quote from VP Security: 'We cannot have vendor-managed keys for production PII. Keys must be in our KMS and rotation audited.'
Data residency: EU production for EU customers (eu-west-1), NA production for US customers (us-east-1). No cross-region storage of PII without explicit legal sign-off.
Security posture: SOC2 in place, pursuing ISO27001; will require vendor attestation and architecture diagrams for security review board.

KMS integration: Customer requires CMKs in AWS KMS with key policy that restricts Redwood from performing key deletion/rotation without customer approval. HSM-backed keys desired for highest-sensitivity workloads.
Audit logging: All inference request metadata and platform events must be forwardable to customer's Splunk/Datadog via private-forwarder; audit trail retention 7 years for legal holds.

VPC topology preferences: single-customer VPC with private subnets for inference nodes, no public ingress. Egress via NAT Gateway or customer-managed egress firewall. Optional Transit Gateway/Direct Connect for low-latency connectivity.

Inbound/outbound specifics: Inbound only from customer IP ranges over VPN/Direct Connect; no public ALB for model endpoints. Outbound to Redwood control plane limited to specific management endpoints and can be pinned to customer-approved IPs.

Region/availability: Want primary in us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Prefer regional model variants pinned per region to satisfy residency. DR plan: warm standby in secondary region, but replication of customer PII disabled by default.

Model & routing: Prefer open LLMs (quantized Llama2-70B or Mistral variants). Need ability to fallback to smaller regional model for latency-sensitive flows. Routing policy must allow customer policy that prefers regional/lowest-cost unless latency SLO violated.

Performance targets: Chat p50 <150ms token latency for interactive assistants; embedding throughput ~50 qps; batchable reranking 200 qps. Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay premium for isolation/KMS control.

POC scope: 1) deploy Private VPC PoC in customer test account, 2) connectivity test (VPN/Direct Connect), 3) CMK key creation & signing test, 4) audit log ingestion to Splunk, 5) latency validation with representative document set.
